teaser: What a sovereign website is: owned and movable, commodity only, seven principles, a maturity model from rented to proven, and every host.
core_idea: A sovereign website is one you own and can move, built only on commodity technology because one proprietary part anywhere is enough to lock it in; seven principles and a maturity model from rented to proven define it, and deploying the same commit to every host proves it.

nodes.label: One proprietary part locks you in

quotes.text: Once there is a piece of proprietary technology in the middle, it does not matter how small it is: you cannot move the site.
Agentic is how the site is built and changed: by a team of agents, and then by your own AI.
